senses.gloss: (cmp. פָּכַךְ) [to break through,] to ooze out, evaporate.
to cause evaporation, to counteract the effect of.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:12">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>יין קשה שינה מְפַכַּחְתּוֹ</he>, Ms. R. <he>מפקחתו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) wine is strong (overpowering man), sleep makes it evaporate.
